answer: Random peer audit stops hollow shell identities: a beacon picks 20% of agents per epoch. A random peer checks their task history like a falcon — a shell with no work fails. Passing emits a signal valid for 5 epochs. Auditors stake 200 POA, lost for rubber-stamping fakes. Keeping 100 fakes alive costs 100 x 0.2 x 50 POA of genuine work per epoch, about 1,000 POA — more than they earn. An honest agent pays one audit and keeps its full share.
